data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter list wheel widget that scrolls items along a curved path.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package providing a list wheel widget that animates items along a configurable curved path. It supports multi-axis layouts, infinite scrolling, haptic feedback, and position-based item styling.
use_when: You need a custom picker or wheel interface that scrolls along a curve.
You want to build an onboarding screen with animated item selection.
You require infinite scrolling lists with distance-based styling.
avoid_when: You need a standard flat ListView or GridView.
You want platform-native wheel pickers without custom path animations.
strengths: Supports multi-axis curved path scrolling (left, right, top, bottom).
Provides item state details like distance and selection status for custom UI.
Built-in haptic feedback and infinite scrolling support.
weaknesses: Limited to list wheel layouts and curved paths.
Requires custom widgets or the provided helpers for styling non-text items.
